notes:
What's new in 1.8:
• New 🏦 Broker files button next to ⬆ Import: bring in your Fidelity Positions and Activity & Orders downloads. OptionIQ shows new trades, closes, stock buys and sells and reinvested dividends, and you choose what to add. Nothing is counted twice
• It also checks your share counts and cost per share against Fidelity and lets you tick the fixes you want
• 🌐 Get from Fidelity opens the Fidelity pages for you; download the files there and OptionIQ picks them up from your Downloads folder by itself
• You can pick several yearly Activity files at once
• New setup step and Settings card "Cost per share": reinvested dividend shares at $0 or at their price, and assigned put shares at the strike or at Fidelity's lower cost

history.notes:
What's new in 1.8:
• New 🏦 Broker files button next to ⬆ Import: bring in your Fidelity Positions and Activity & Orders downloads. OptionIQ shows new trades, closes, stock buys and sells and reinvested dividends, and you choose what to add. Nothing is counted twice
• It also checks your share counts and cost per share against Fidelity and lets you tick the fixes you want
• 🌐 Get from Fidelity opens the Fidelity pages for you; download the files there and OptionIQ picks them up from your Downloads folder by itself
• You can pick several yearly Activity files at once
• New setup step and Settings card "Cost per share": reinvested dividend shares at $0 or at their price, and assigned put shares at the strike or at Fidelity's lower cost

What's new in 1.7:
• A small Week | Month switch above the boxes on 📋 Options: Month shows this month's net P&L, this month's premium and the average monthly net P&L. Your choice is remembered
• 📱 The phone app's Home screen now shows the same 8 boxes as the computer, with the same Week | Month switch

What's new in 1.6:
• 📱 Works with the new OptionIQ phone app: log, close, roll and fix trades and add watchlist stocks on your iPhone; OptionIQ adds them here within a minute or two (your data folder must be in OneDrive). A window lists each change as it comes in
• Close / Roll and ✏️ Edit now ask for the close price per share (for example 0.30), with no minus sign. OptionIQ works out the total with the $0.67 fee, just like a new trade
• Date boxes start on today's date
• The update notice shows only what's new since your version, with the buttons at the top

New in 1.5.1:
• 📊 Excel no longer stops with "Invalid count value" when a week had more options bought than sold
• Opening a second copy of OptionIQ (for example a test copy) no longer moves your desktop icon to that copy

New in 1.5:
• ＋ New Trade and ＋ New Holding now open in a pop-up window, so you can always see them, even when the page is scrolled down
• ✏️ Edit on a trade or holding also opens a pop-up with large boxes that show the current values

New in 1.4:
• ⬆ Import now works with your own spreadsheet layout. OptionIQ guesses which column is which, you fix any wrong guess from drop-down lists, and you see a preview before anything is saved
• Understands words like Put/Call, Sell/Buy, Sell to Open, Closed and Expired, picks the right sheet in an Excel file, and skips totals rows
• Clear Add and Replace buttons, and your column choices are remembered for next time

New in 1.3.2:
• New versions are offered as soon as you start the app
• Updates are much faster, show an "Updating OptionIQ" window and reopen the app by themselves

New in 1.3:
• Screener gives each trade a 0–100 Score and lists the best first (hover over the Score to see why)
• Weekly and Monthly quick settings in the Screener
• New 🔁 Roll candidates: shows roll choices for your open puts and calls, with your own settings for days, delta, in the money, and puts or calls
• Premiums shown after the $0.67 fee
• Warnings for upcoming dividends, too much in one sector, and price support levels
• The price message at the top can now be closed with ✕
